title: Research: PR589 whole-call hosting in the exact stream model (no new kappa)
head: 7943acd4b430dd4286e32954237136ee9657be3b
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Selected PR589 can place five helpers of one call in the same physical family, while PR540's concrete source provider covers an older word with rank-eight COPY transport. This package gives a **written, source-bound whole-call hosting proof in the exact stream model**, with independent exact certificates for the selected word's owner maps and nine rank-seven COPY/ERASE pairs.

The five-helper fixture uses distinct cover classes and disjoint pending supports in family 666. The argument then covers both complete 27,234-instruction programs, all 661 symbolic input columns, 636 frame projectors, 288 stage/replica descriptors, and chronological composition through the actual idle windows. Arbitrarily correlated dirty helper contents and prior outputs are retained between calls. The cover-sweep argument assumes enumeration of every element of the finite orthogonal group.

Only the new [research package](https://github.com/alephnan/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7943acd4b430dd4286e32954237136ee9657be3b/research/pr589-five-helper-hosting/README.md) is added. The recursive profile, selected frontier and frozen sources are unchanged. **No new kappa, PR589 Lean provider, all-size compiler, or admission of the explicit charts to the routing/finite-invoice budget is claimed.** The executable finite certificates support the [written proof](https://github.com/alephnan/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7943acd4b430dd4286e32954237136ee9657be3b/research/pr589-five-helper-hosting/PROOF.md); they do not replace those remaining obligations.

## Task and overlap

Task: `bit-helper-contract`, priority revision 2; **scope changed** under the explicit assignment from semantic H2/K replacement to selected-source physical hosting. PR1194/1311 already address semantic helper preconditioning. This contribution investigates a separate retained hosting premise; [TASK.json](https://github.com/alephnan/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7943acd4b430dd4286e32954237136ee9657be3b/research/pr589-five-helper-hosting/TASK.json) records the boundary and stopping rule.

Research base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`. Selected PR589 source head: `a5afc8c6169ea61ba7c51dfd3cade02cc7b13b46`. Exact retained input blobs and hashes are in [SOURCES.json](https://github.com/alephnan/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7943acd4b430dd4286e32954237136ee9657be3b/research/pr589-five-helper-hosting/SOURCES.json).

The submission overlap refresh at 2026-10-14 04:14-04:15 UTC covered 733 open PRs and 259 discussion records with complete pagination. All five heads above were rechecked. Coverage includes PR/discussion text and local package metadata, not every diff or unpublished result; it is not a novelty certificate. Current upstream main `0a201997097b8a89b638f3a2afcb35db4184c8b2` retains the same pinned inputs and package workflow.

## Validation

Passed on Windows CPython 3.12.2:

```sh
python -X utf8 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr589-five-helper-hosting --check-only
python -X utf8 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr589-five-helper-hosting
python -X utf8 -B research/e8-bit-p111-tuned/code/xcheck_p.py research/e8-bit-p111-tuned/tune/bitE8mut-p111-tuned.json.gz
```

- The registered independent standard-library checker passes normally and under `-O`; all ten malformed controls reject. Controls include coherent owner collisions, wrong supports/windows, stale MOVE frames, rank-eight substitution, wrong rank-seven frame, premature ERASE and missing cleanup.
- The predecessor checker passes all 661 columns and H1-H5 (SymPy 1.13.3).
- All 1,579 selected-source bindings pass; the Windows long-path invocation is recorded in [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/alephnan/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7943acd4b430dd4286e32954237136ee9657be3b/research/pr589-five-helper-hosting/VALIDATION.md).
- The **unchanged native PR589 supplier cold replay** exits zero in 377 seconds, including native legality/column checks, source reconstruction, hosted mutations and historical cited assemblies. Its WSL environment, exact command, versions and hashes are retained in [NATIVE-REPLAY.json](https://github.com/alephnan/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7943acd4b430dd4286e32954237136ee9657be3b/research/pr589-five-helper-hosting/NATIVE-REPLAY.json).
- Fresh versus archived proof-relevant outputs match. Geometry differs only in runtime `seconds`, with the corresponding raw geometry-hash reference; the narrowly normalized complete-template digest matches.
- Diff whitespace and package metadata/source-pin checks pass.

Not run: a new Lean source-provider build or the broader `make frontier1094-verify`, which also replays unchanged complex/composition ancestry. Native replay verifies the frozen supplier's own scope; it does not admit the new explicit charts to its cost model. No independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

[Next questions and concrete first steps](https://github.com/alephnan/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7943acd4b430dd4286e32954237136ee9657be3b/research/pr589-five-helper-hosting/README.md#open-next-questions): instantiate the nine literal rank-seven pairs and 661-role source in PR540's Lean framework; then lower the explicit slot/port charts to the actual compiler and bind routes, inverses, exceptional cover handling and costs to the retained invoice. These are the blockers to a stronger implementation-level claim.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
